text:
Leah: Quick thread — experiment idea for the plans page before next week's webinar. want to test a simplified grid + micro-FAQ and route webinar signups differently.
Owen: sounds good. what's the hypothesis?
Leah: hypothesis = fewer words, clearer per-unit cost, and a one-click estimator will increase trial signups and demo requests from mid-market leads.
Ravi: i like testing clarity. can we avoid the long tariff table? maybe show 3 core value props per plan instead.
Priya: +1. also suggest renaming options away from generic 'Starter / Pro / Enterprise' — test more descriptive labels. current idea: "Launch" (low-commit), "Scale" (predictable), "Shield" (compliance).
Marta: love the names. will they map to existing SKU logic? need product sign-off on mappings and limits.
Leah: yes, mapping is 1:1 to current SKUs, just alternative labels for the experiment. no infra changes.
Owen: what's the estimator variant? interactive or static?
Leah: two variants: (A) mini estimator — dropdown for expected monthly tokens + sliding concurrency -> outputs monthly cost estimate (rounded) and recommended plan; (B) simple per-seat slider that assumes typical token profile. both small code snippets embedded, no backend.
Ravi: opt for client-side JS only, hits no new API. example snippet: `const estimate = tokensPerMonth * tokensPrice + concurrency * concurrencyPrice;` keep it approximate.
Priya: routing: webinar signups should include a hidden field `lead_segment=pricing-experiment` and map to HubSpot list. Sales wants tags: `experiment=plan-grid-2026` and `notify=sales-eng@redwood.com`.
Sam (sales-bot): heaDsup — I can auto-create tasks for leads with `lead_score>50` and `experiment` tag. confirm the threshold.
Marta: confirm lead_score=50 works. also request a short FAQ tweak: collapse answers into one line with a "read more" link for full FAQ. try 3 questions: "How is usage billed?", "Can I reserve capacity?", "Is data private?"
Leah: timeline: copy freeze tomorrow EOD, dev slot for client-side estimator on Wed, QA Thu, soft launch Fri morning, webinar Mon.
Owen: A/B metrics — primary = trial start CTR from page, secondary = demo request rate, revenue-weighted leads. gate experiments by region (US/EU) for compliance.
Priya: tracking plan: add `utm_experiment=plan_clarity_v1`, `lead_segment` hidden field, and a GA event `cost_estimate_view`.
Ravi: any accessibility concerns for the slider? will add keyboard support and ARIA labels.
Leah: perfect. action items: Leah to finalize copy (today), Ravi impl estimator (Wed), Priya set HubSpot mapping + UTMs, Owen build GA events + dashboard, Marta coordinate sales notifications.
Marta: will draft the sales micro-brief and snippets for outreach templates (1-liner + link).
Sam (sales-bot): I'll run a quick smoke: when form submits with `experiment=plan-grid-clarity` create hs_task for sales-queue and ping #sales-inbound.
Leah: thanks team — post any objections here, otherwise will ship the copy to staging by 6pm. :rocket:
